ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture（中世日本 - 文化）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Uses ordinary sittable furniture as meal destinations without requiring an adjacent table; preserves standard table-adjacent seating and Vanilla fallback. Independently neutralizes AteWithoutTable mood effect. Requires Harmony. One original Vanilla 1.6 scenario confirmed table-free Stool dining and Comfort, priority of a Stool adjoining a table, and standing fallback with no chair; Pickle 1/1, runtime ERROR 0. The original MO RusticStool table-free meal/Comfort passed on the earlier 8,704-byte DLL with two external audio clips WAV-converted inside the isolated clone; the current 9,216-byte 1.7 DLL passed genuine Vanilla 1.7 chair/Comfort/table-priority/fallback and 43 adult + 24 childhood background checks on the preceding binary (Pickle 1/1, runtime ERROR 0). The current 1.6 binary, original-MP3 MO ERROR-zero, other chairs, dining-room Thoughts and saved-game loading are not individually accepted by this 1.7 check. Also restricts ordinary new generation of 48 anachronistic adult backgrounds, 24 fixed childhood biographies, and 2 shuffled childhood backgrounds. Earlier original real-game runs verified 43 adult and 24 child exclusions in Vanilla 1.7 on the preceding DLL; three new SF adult exclusions and the Greedy/Jealous shared-lodging effects are source-built for 1.6 and 1.7 but not yet native accepted. The additional 2 adult and 2 shuffled-child XML rules have not yet been tested in-game; no new DLL is required. Existing saves keep their Def references. The original 32 reusable Vanilla SF backgrounds plus two additional forced-trait-aware histories (34 total) now have historical-Japanese career narratives in English and Japanese; six new-bio starting-item grants use period-compatible supplies instead of futuristic materials, drugs or rations. Existing saved identities and items remain. Source XML and translations are installed, but loaded-game wording, item grants and compatibility are not yet accepted. Shared-barracks Greedy and Jealous now evaluate assigned barracks impressiveness instead of insisting on private bedrooms; standard private-bedroom behavior and trait identifiers are retained. New 1.6 and 1.7 DLLs have been compiled and packaged; loaded-game acceptance remains open. MO integration, preexisting-save reload and the 34 narrative/6 item-grant outputs remain separately untested. A separate optional MO-only XML patch retains corpse-sighting familiarity while restoring Vanilla grief for a liked pawn and prisoner-treatment judgments suppressed by MO Fighter/Veteran; static XML/XPath check only, loaded-game behavior untested.
RimWorld 1.6／1.7向け開発版。通常のイスをテーブルなしでも食事場所として選択する。テーブルに隣接するイスの優先と、利用可能なイスがない場合の標準処理を維持。「テーブルなしで食事」の心情ペナルティは別処理で0にする。Harmony必須。Vanilla 1.6でスツール単独での食事と快適性上昇、テーブル隣接イスの優先、イスがない場合の立ち食い完了を確認（Pickle 1/1、実行時ERROR 0）。MOのRusticStoolも旧8,704バイトDLLと隔離コピー内の音声WAV変換で着席・快適性上昇・食事完了を確認した。現行1.7専用9,216バイトDLLで、Vanilla 1.7のイス単独食事・快適性・テーブル優先・イスなし食事を実ゲーム確認（Pickle 1/1、ERROR 0）。現行1.6 DLLのMO併用、元MP3のERROR 0、他のイス、食堂心情は未確認。時代不適切な成人期背景48件、固定人物の幼少期背景24件、通常シャッフル生成の幼少期背景2件を新規通常生成から制限する。追加4件はXMLのみの修正で、実ゲームでの確認は未完了。従来の成人43件・幼少期24件は前版DLLを使用したVanilla 1.7実ゲームで確認済み（ERROR 0）。成人期の追加3件と共同寝所の特性処理は新しい1.6／1.7 DLLへビルド済みで、実ゲーム未検証。旧セーブ読み込み、MO併用は未検証。加えて、廻船商人・密荷運び・海上の略奪者・猟師・炊事役・算木使い・鉱山の孤児・施しの世話役・水軍の兵・兵法家・奉公人など、転用可能と判定した背景32件に、強制特性を維持した新たな2件を加えた計34件を中世日本の人物経歴として英日改稿した。未来的な初期所持品を含む6件は、通常の金属・薬草薬・簡単な食事へ変更する。既存セーブの人物・所持アイテム定義は残す。ゲーム内の英日表示・新規生成時の所持品と互換性は未検証。特性「強欲」「嫉妬」は共同寝所に限って寝所の豪華さで判定し、個室に限る前提を改める。特性定義と個室の元処理は残す。この新処理は1.6／1.7のDLLに収録済みで、実ゲーム確認は未完了。別途MO導入時だけ適用するXMLパッチで、戦士・古参兵の死体目撃への慣れは残し、親しい人物の死と捕虜の処遇に関するVanilla心情を復帰する。XML／XPathのみ静的確認済み、実ゲーム確認は未実施。
